evidence: A trip that normally takes about 30 minutes ended up taking an hour
note: No amount contested, so CLS-02 falls back to stated order; the 30-to-60-minute trip is the first issue that matches a dispute leaf (FC-ROUTE: longer trip duration). Cash-only insistence = FC-PAYMENT, Amoy vs Club Street = EX-LOCATION, 15-min late arrival = EX-FEEDBACK. FC-PAYMENT primary is the main alternative.

evidence: The driver also cancelled the booking, but Ms [NAME] was still charged a cancellation fee.
note: Driver-cancelled booking with the fee charged to the rider (S$4.30) = no-show fee. Yelling/rude driver is EX-FEEDBACK; not CLS-01 safety language.

evidence: he wanted to drop me off in the rain when there's a shelter right in front?
note: Drop-off point complaint with no charge contested; rider already rated and gave feedback (CLS-03).

evidence: he don't want to cancel the booking!
note: Driver drove off but refused to cancel, so the S$5.30 fee followed the rider's own cancellation. Who canceled is inferred, not stated.

evidence: He was there but drove off when he saw I was standing and talking to someone in a wheelchair
note: No fee; driver canceled late, rider lodged a complaint and got a voucher. Refusing a wheelchair-accompanied rider has no dedicated type (refusal of service / discrimination).

evidence: The driver should be asking instead of shouting (at us) and driving off.
note: Conduct complaint with no fee and no remedy (CLS-03). Driving off without pickup is a CW-DRIVERNOSHOW secondary. Shouting is rudeness, not CLS-01 language.

evidence: He was being intrusive, racist and threatened my safety
note: CLS-01 (threats). Accelerating when she asked to alight = SE-DRIVING. Demand that she pay his commission has no specific FC leaf (FC-OTHER).

evidence: the driver stopped the car and asked her to get out
note: Rider put out mid-trip; SE claim is primary (CLS-02). Borderline shouting = rudeness; pick-up pin mistake = EX-LOCATION.

evidence: You just get a blank screen: the app does not work.
note: First stated issue is laggy location service, plus blank help screen; auto 5-star rating = EX-RATING; unspecified horrible ride = EX-FEEDBACK. No charge contested.

evidence: the vehicle whose driver accepted the ride remained in the same position on the map and was not moving
note: Driver stalled instead of coming; no fee charged and no remedy stated, so CLS-03 routes it to support although the type is CW-DRIVERNOSHOW.

evidence: the woman began hitting and scratching the driver's arm once again
note: CLS-01 (assault by rider on driver). SE-CONDUCT is closest but its label does not name physical assault. Rider's longer-route grievance, reported by the driver, is an FC-ROUTE secondary.

evidence: did not even pick him up from his location but he was charged for the trip nevertheless
note: Charged for a trip without pickup. Driver's app-fault excuse is his explanation, not a separate rider claim.

evidence: You didn't reply nor pick me up
note: Ride marked completed and charged without pickup; fee present so not CW-DRIVERNOSHOW. Unreachable support line = EX-OTHER.

evidence: it was marked as completed, even though she was nowhere near my location.
note: 54-second, 16 km 'completed' trip charged to card. Non-responsive support = EX-OTHER.

evidence: his screen showed the rate as SGD21.10 (RM64)
note: Driver's fare (S$21.10) differs from the rider's booked fare (S$14.10). Only FC-OTHER catch-all fits; needs a 'booked/upfront fare vs charged fare mismatch' type. Driver yelling = EX-FEEDBACK.

evidence: accused the former of kidnapping her on their trip from Bishan to the city
note: Safety allegation (CLS-01) with no specific SE leaf; only SE-OTHER catch-all fits. Needs an abduction / unsafe route deviation safety type.

evidence: the payment had not been made at all
note: Driver claims an unpaid S$18 fare (cash trip, fake PayNow payment).

evidence: he didn't bring us to Bedok, asking me [to] pay S$30 to him for halfway only!
note: Driver ended the fixed-fare trip midway; SE claim is primary (CLS-02). The extra S$30 demand has no specific leaf (FC-OTHER).

evidence: he had added a S$5 charge for 'VIP treatment'
note: Rider contests an unagreed driver-added surcharge. FC-SURCHARGE examples are official fees, so the fit rests on 'surcharge'; an unauthorized driver add-on charge type is missing.

evidence: submitted a claim for the maximum S$120 reimbursement under Grab's cleaning fee policy
note: Driver's cleaning-fee claim (vomit) rejected for receipt format. Forced cancellation of next job hurting his cancellation rate has no specific leaf (CW-OTHER).
